visible_enemies: only live enemy objects accepted by LeaderData::is_enemy for the unique local human
only objects currently accepted by the shipped concrete UnitData, AnimalData, BuildData, or WallData is_seen leaf
stable identity {slot,band,o,uid}, public type/class, position, hits, flags, and unit heading
observation_delta_from_v3.fog_rule: no remembered-but-currently-hidden object, enemy economy/order/queue, raw fog plane, or terrain cell is published
observation_delta_from_v3.class_gate: unknown or layout-compatible-looking object classes fail the entire observation closed before a direct shipped leaf call

scout_frontier.policy: Arena Marshal's persistent 12-leg citizen ring geometry
scout_frontier.candidate_order: one 192-Coord diagonal step toward the goal, then its X-only and Y-only cardinal fallbacks
oracle_order: convert the candidate through the shipped div_3_table pointer
require WorldData::is_really_seen for the candidate F cell and local slot
only then call shipped WorldData::is_passable for its W cell
scout_frontier.apply_replay: repeat the same current-fog/passability query at the identical paused public-state token and require the same destination before MOVE_TO

visible_attack.apply_replay: repeat owner/enemy relation, active object identity, concrete class, uid, and current shipped visibility in the paused main-thread callback
visible_attack.command: attack-visible calls shipped CommandManager::issue_attack and requires a front AttackOrder resolving to the same owner/o/uid

supervised_marshal_state.push_gate: Massing enters Pushing only with an observed enemy base and own live military value at least Level::MARSHAL.push_threshold=420
supervised_marshal_state.retreat_gate: Pushing returns to Massing after an observed loss greater than 60 percent of the push value
supervised_marshal_state.transaction: one queue, build, move, or attack-visible command per decision; exact 1..30-frame boundary; every decision starts and ends paused

proof.move: retail-generated opcode 0x07, exact applied MoveOrder destination, stable actor identity, and same-frame post-command public observation
proof.attack: retail-generated attack opcode, exact applied AttackOrder owner/o/uid, stable actor/target identities, and same-frame post-command public observation
proof.loop: pinned executable/player/world identity, persistent tactical state, exact frame delta, pause restoration, and STOP-restored call-site bytes

excluded: enemy and neutral economy, queues, orders, diplomacy internals, or private targets
raw fog, terrain, passability, ownership, blocker, danger, or resource planes
passability or attack validation before current-visibility replay
unsupported object classes or unresolved object/order identities
direct state writes, guessed targets, or substituted commands
fail_closed: wrong executable identity or call-site bytes
ambiguous local human or torn public observation
unknown concrete object or order vtable
truncated own or visible-enemy object set
changed frame, pause, public state, actor uid, target uid, visibility, or legality replay
wrong serialized opcode or missing exact applied order
